created_by_notebook: Household Electricity Carbon XAI final workflow
cohort_rule: At least five quality-passing full months within May-November, with early- and late-window representation
classification_target: mean_monthly_emissions_kg at or above the development-set Q75 threshold

teacher_variable_units.floor_area: square feet as recorded in Wave 1
teacher_variable_units.n_acs: number of AC units in the Wave 1 AC roster
teacher_variable_units.n_appliances: number of appliance records in the Wave 1 appliance roster
teacher_variable_units.avg_hours_home: mean member hours at home during the previous week

teacher_code_variables_intentionally_exc.final_cluster: derived from the temporal features and not an independent household predictor

selection_rules.regression: lowest honest nested development OOF MAE; RMSE then R2 tie-break
selection_rules.classification: highest honest nested development OOF PR-AUC; nested OOF balanced accuracy then F1 tie-break
selection_rules.classification_decision_threshold: maximized balanced accuracy using honest nested development OOF probabilities

nested_cv.classification_outer_split_strategy: shuffled KFold independent of global target labels

evaluation_scope: Internal household-level held-out test; cross-sectional, not future forecasting
